subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Binary Code and Myth
description: A 60-second lesson on Binary Code and Myth.

hook.text: Computers run on ones and zeros. The two most mythically significant digits now power all digital reality.

buildup.text: Leibniz created binary math in 1703 and linked it to the I Ching's system of broken and unbroken lines.

discovery.text: The I Ching uses yin and yang—zero and one—to generate 64 hexagrams. Ancient China encoded binary logic.

twist.text: Leibniz saw binary as proof of creation from nothing. One is God. Zero is the void. Together they build reality.

climax.text: From Chinese philosophy to Leibniz to your phone—the sacred pair of one and zero shapes every digital moment.

punchline.text: On and off. Being and void. That's all it takes.

quiz.question: Who linked binary mathematics to the I Ching?
